dialog.title: Import statement
dialog.desc: The file becomes a plan; nothing is saved until you confirm, and the whole import can be undone later.

nav.commit: Import {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}
nav.apply: Apply {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}

file.drop: Drag the statement or card bill here, or
file.help: Accepts OFX, CSV, card bill PDFs and photos/screenshots. You can also drop several files or send them to the assistant.
file.many: {first} and {count, plural, one {# more file} other {# more files}}
file.assistantNote: PDFs and photos are read by the assistant: it builds the plan from the file and you confirm it in the conversation.
file.ofxHint: OFX gives the most reliable match: when you import the bill again (open, then closed), each purchase is recognized by the bank's identifier.
file.partial: The file does not cover the whole {month} bill: nothing already on it will be removed.

hints.cardNumber: Detected from the card number in the file
hints.accountNumber: Detected from the account number in the file
hints.only: The only account of this type
hints.chooseCard: Choose the card for this bill
hints.chooseAccount: Choose the account for this statement

linkBill: Link to the {month} bill (due {due}) and do not count the bill payment as spending
linkBillNoDue: Link to the {month} bill and do not count the bill payment as spending

review.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} · categories you choose here become rules for future statements
review.removedNote: no longer on the bill · check it to move it to the trash

confirm.card: The {bank} bill for {month} will have {count, plural, one {# purchase} other {# purchases}} totaling {total}.
confirm.cardPayment: The {due} payment comes out of {account} and does not count as spending.
confirm.cardPaymentNoAccount: The {due} payment does not count as spending.
confirm.transfers: {count, plural, one {# row is booked as a transfer (bill payment, contribution or between entities) and does not count as spending.} other {# rows are booked as transfers (bill payments, contributions or between entities) and do not count as spending.}}
confirm.cardUpdated: {count, plural, one {# changed entry is updated, keeping its category.} other {# changed entries are updated, keeping their categories.}}
confirm.cardRemoved: {count, plural, one {# entry that left the bill goes to the trash.} other {# entries that left the bill go to the trash.}}

done.title: {count, plural, one {# transaction imported} other {# transactions imported}} into {account}
done.body: All reviewed. The view “{view}” was created so you can check it.
done.removed: {count, plural, one {# entry that left the bill went to the trash.} other {# entries that left the bill went to the trash.}}
